# #2542 continuation: exact target-failure storage observation

The existing closed delivery row-family owner now owns the two original target
failure SELECTs. They retain exact original event, target-unreachable class and
pin-routing handler predicates, the original detail-code projection and each
dialect's original JSON/text defaults. No run, status, eligibility, success,
ordering or limiting predicate is added. The private adapter invokes that owner
in one original native read transaction and returns detached reason/target text;
any validation, read or commit failure discards all evidence.

Both real target-refusal bus roots consume this fixed projection. SQLite's exact
pipeline cardinality uses the existing canonical receipt owner. The PostgreSQL
root now needs no raw pool and uses the existing native factory. Actual target
planning, excluded sibling descriptors/subscriptions, publish, reason/target and
receipt assertions remain unchanged. These are storage witnesses, not routing
or lifecycle authority.

The complete-root inverse alters only construction and the read cuts. It checks
both copied dialect SQL bodies against their originals, and rejects changed
event, fabricated reason/target and altered publication assertions. Both-store
private controls record lawful dead letters through existing domain owners and
prove unrelated event/class/handler rows cannot satisfy the witness. A positive
nonempty read proves one original read commit/no writes. Missing, invalid,
foreign, cancelled and closed paths provide no partial evidence or retained work.
The initial missing flow coordinate in a new lawful-record probe was corrected
through the domain record; no raw seed or production relaxation earns proof.

Only exact private bounded operations receive the existing fixture-2151
classification; no new guard/collector allowance, selector, callback, raw getter,
reconstructed coordinator or framework. Existing raw_sql_policy, watchlist and
approved gate apply; no production architecture/runtime semantic change or new
spec teaching. Counts and named proofs are on #2542. No core/full, hosted,
server2, fork-deadline or parent closure claim.
